title: Open MicroManipulator – A sub-micrometer 3D motion control plattform
summary: Open MicroManipulator is an open-source hardware project providing sub-micrometer precision 3D motion control using stepper motors, designed for scientific research, microscopy, and nanofabrication applications where ultra-precise positioning is critical.
problem_solved: Provides affordable sub-micrometer precision positioning capabilities that were previously only achievable with expensive commercial systems costing thousands of dollars.
why_valuable: democratizes precision motion control by offering an open-source, low-cost alternative for researchers and hobbyists working in nanotechnology, microscopy, and microscale assembly.
